Record Class PyprojectModel.Processor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.PyprojectModel.Processor
Record Components:
mode - processor execution mode (for example jvm or native)
incremental - whether incremental compilation is enabled
pythonIncrementalMode - handling of dynamic or unresolved Python relationships
daemon - whether the compiler daemon is enabled
Enclosing class:
PyprojectModel
